gloss: to reveal, to disclose; to spend (the night)

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {明|あ}かしていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to reveal, to disclose, to confess
definitions.explanation: To make something hidden or secret known. Often used for revealing one's identity, a secret, or the truth.

definitions.gloss: to spend (the night), to stay up all night
definitions.explanation: To pass the night doing something. Often used in the pattern 〜{明|あ}かす to mean spending the entire night engaged in an activity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{明|あ}かした。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{正体|しょうたい}→正体：13190_shoutai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{明|あ}かさなかった。
examples.english: He did not reveal his true identity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{隠|かく}していた→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{明|あ}かす⟦{決心|けっしん}→決心：02700_kesshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I decided to reveal to my friend the past I had hidden for years.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一晩|ひとばん}→一晩：08887_hitoban⟧{語|かた}り{明|あ}かした。
examples.english: We talked through the entire night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{明|あ}かした。
examples.english: I stayed up all night studying for the exam.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{飲|の}み{明|あ}かして、⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{帰|かえ}れなかった→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I drank through the night with a friend and couldn't go home until morning.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive).

USAGE:
Sense 1 takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ to mark what is revealed: ⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{明|あ}かす, ⟦{正体|しょうたい}→正体：13190_shoutai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{明|あ}かす.
Sense 2 is often used as a compound verb suffix: V⟦{連用形|れんようけい}→連用形：16646_renyoukei⟧ + {明|あ}かす (e.g., {語|かた}り{明|あ}かす, {飲|の}み{明|あ}かす). Also used as ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{明|あ}かす (to spend the whole night).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{明|あ}かす: to reveal a secret
- ⟦{正体|しょうたい}→正体：13190_shoutai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{明|あ}かす: to reveal one's identity
- ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{明|あ}かす: to stay up all night
- {語|かた}り{明|あ}かす: to talk all night long
- {飲|の}み{明|あ}かす: to drink all night long

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{暴|あば}く→暴く：04607_abaku⟧: to expose, to uncover (forceful)
- ⟦{打|う}ち{明|あ}ける→打ち明ける：04230_uchiakeru⟧: to confide, to open up about
